proposition.object:
## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 30 outcomes and 454 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **New York City**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 1 cents; 52 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Miami**: 32% (bid 31 cents, ask 33 cents; 49 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Oklahoma City**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 35 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **San Antonio**: 13% (bid 12 cents, ask 14 cents; 30 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Austin**: 19% (bid 17 cents, ask 20 cents; 28 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Atlanta**: 100% (bid 99 cents, ask 100 cents; 25 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **College Station**: 95% (bid 93 cents, ask 96 cents; 23 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Philadelphia**: 3% (bid 1 cents, ask 4 cents; 23 thousand contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxrain/where-will-it-rain-daily/kxrain-26oct03) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

We have no model of our own for this market, so the odds above are the traders' consensus and not an independent estimate. For calibration: in our sample of settled Climate and Weather markets, the Kalshi mid-price a day before close scored a Brier error of 0.0879 (a coin-flip price scores 0.25; lower is better).

## How does this market resolve?

> If the total precipitation at CLINYC in New York City in Oct 3, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 4, 2026 at 05:00 UTC. Expected settlement: October 5, 2026 at 03:59 UTC. Settlement source: [The Weather Company](https://weather.com/kalshi). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/RAINGLOBALPERIOD.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- A new National Blend of Models or National Weather Service forecast run, issued hourly.
- For a same-day high, the maximum already observed at the station (the day's high cannot settle below it); for a low, the minimum so far.
- A correction or late revision to the NWS Daily Climate Report that settles the market.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 359 settled Climate and Weather markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.0879; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 1.8% of the time (109 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (5 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "Where will it rain on Oct 3, 2026"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies Miami at 32%, Austin at 19%, and Houston at 86%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxrain/where-will-it-rain-daily/kxrain-26oct03.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 4, 2026 at 05:00 UTC and is expected to settle October 5, 2026 at 03:59 UTC, in about 9 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names The Weather Company (https://weather.com/kalshi) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/RAINGLOBALPERIOD.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

Kalshi is a federally regulated exchange (a CFTC-designated contract market). Whether you can trade depends on your location and eligibility under Kalshi's terms. The market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxrain/where-will-it-rain-daily/kxrain-26oct03.

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.
